annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于印发“互联网+政务服务”技术体系建设指南的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council on Issuing the Guide to Building the Technical System for "Internet + Government Services"
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.summary_en: China State Council General Office notice issuing a guide for building a nationally integrated "Internet + Government Services" technical system: platform architecture, real-name user authentication, e-licences, data sharing and exchange, security, and monitoring and third-party evaluation. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Provincial and ministry online government service platforms to be built by end-2017; national integrated system by 2020
Three-tier national/provincial/municipal platform architecture with unified data exchange and sharing
Real-name registration, unified identity authentication, e-licences and e-seals
Standardised service item lists, guides and review rules, with electronic supervision
Security protection per classified protection rules; third-party evaluation indicator system
